idf_component_register(
    SRCS 
        "main.c" 
        "bsp_backlight.c" 
        "bsp_display.c" 
        "clock_ui.c" 
        "fonts/lv_font_cjk_clock_18.c" 
        "fonts/weather_icons.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS 
        "." 
        "fonts"
    REQUIRES 
        esp_driver_ledc esp_lcd_jd9855 esp_lcd_touch_ft5x06 esp_lvgl_port lvgl
)

# LVGL fonts generated by lv_font_conv use a conditional include:
#   #ifdef LV_LVGL_H_INCLUDE_SIMPLE
#       #include "lvgl.h"
#   #else
#       #include "lvgl/lvgl.h"
#   #endif
# The managed lvgl component exports its root dir (where lvgl.h lives) as an
# include dir, so only "lvgl.h" resolves. Define the macro to pick that branch.
target_compile_definitions(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE "LV_LVGL_H_INCLUDE_SIMPLE=1")
